root_cause: The researcher regenerated a plan that re-emitted already-completed work as pending. The merge logic replaced the plan wholesale, so the pipeline re-attempted accepted steps and re-initialized state that had already been validated.

details.rule: When merging a new plan into existing state, preserve completed steps by status boundary. The researcher's prompt must include the full plan history with explicit COMPLETED/PENDING markers so the model does not re-emit finished work.
